summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Canadian material change report dated November 2, 2026, disclosing that its 100%-owned Fenn-Gib Gold Project in the Timmins region of Northern Ontario was selected as a designated project under Ontario's new 'One Project, One Process' framework. The designation creates a single point of contact through the Ministry of Energy and Mines to coordinate provincial approvals and Indigenous consultation, targeting a 50% reduction in government review time, with permits potentially secured by 2028 and production as early as 2030. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is a routine regulatory-permitting disclosure, not a special situation; watch permitting milestones and any resulting strategic interest.
